name: Rogue Lineage
description: Shows mana as a percentage over the mana bar with marked spell ranges. Shades hotbar skills while they cool down, with a countdown, and tells the Autoclicker widget when the backpack is open so it can pause. Automates snap training and blacksmithing with keys and clicks while Roblox is focused. Windows only. Reads the screen, hotbar keys, and mouse clicks on this device, and Roblox's sound while snap training is on. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
